rationale: The redesign makes a single-OEM, read-only, event-priced diagnostic and verification report the sole initial product, sold around an avoided service visit or quantified retrofit decision through the family-company pilot and then three unrelated installers. Economically, it replaces an unvalidated recurring fee with a 300-700 PLN per-report hypothesis whose value and contribution margin can be observed per event, while deferring continuous monitoring, remote control and multi-OEM support costs; durable repeat demand and wealth-scale expansion remain unknown.
